Latin word

expositiō

expositiō, expositiōnis f.

noun, third declension · Declension on Wiktionary

a setting out of facts, an account; an exhibition; a setting forth, a presentation

In this lexicon

  • account

    also used · classical · Cic. Or. 212: expositiōnēs rērum (Lewis & Short); Quint. 2.4.15

  • exhibition

    the recommended word · modern · Levi–Bini p. 42

  • presentation

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Or. 212: expositiōnēs rērum (Lewis & Short); Quint. 4.2.2

Examples

  • Crās tabulās pictās quae in mūsēō prōpositae sunt vīsēmus.

    Tomorrow we’ll go and see the pictures on show at the museum.composed

    In the entry for exhibition

  • Crās rem collēgīs expōnere dēbeō.

    I have to give a presentation to my colleagues tomorrow.composed

    In the entry for presentation
